$comment: Source of truth for the README's progress section. Edit here, then run npm run progress:write. An item with an integration id is done once that catalog entry is built. Targets are estimates; move them as plans change.

milestones.name: Foundation
milestones.value: Every record is validated, stored once and traceable to its source.

items.name: Seven-layer pipeline with idempotent ingestion and dead letters
Database with row-level security and migrations
Secret scanning, CI and the break-it check on every change
Identity resolution and documentation drift checks

milestones.name: Retail departments
milestones.value: Eleven departments that turn store data into daily recommendations.

items.name: Sales, inventory, clienteling, repairs, custom orders, appraisals, buying, metals, marketing, finance and compliance
Turn departments on per business
A dollar estimate on each recommendation: money made, saved or protected
Value ledger: what acting on a recommendation brought back, measured at 30, 60 and 90 days
Tune thresholds against a live store's data

milestones.name: Core integrations
milestones.value: Connects what most jewelers already run: online store, POS, payments, bank and books.

items.name: Bank and card statements from CSV exports
Bank and card statements from PDFs

milestones.name: Client instances
milestones.value: Each business gets its own isolated instance, in accounts it owns.

items.name: Instance API locked to one organization
Published container image with a real-database smoke test
Guided secrets setup that never prints a value
Connectors sync on a schedule, each on its own checkpoint
Raw vendor data cleared after a set number of days
Writes to a client's systems behind approvals, off by default
First live client instance

milestones.name: Website and demo
milestones.value: Jewelers can see what KaratOS does for their business before they talk to us.

items.name: Website at karatos.app with pricing, payback estimate and a directory of every system
Live demo store at karatos.app/demo
Private form for reporting a broken system
Demo walkthroughs of the biggest jeweler problems
Homepage video of the live dashboard solving real problems

milestones.name: AI reasoning

items.name: Claude-powered reasoner with provenance and confidence
Owner feedback tunes future recommendations
Semantic search over the business's documents

items.name: Integrations list in the instance API for the Brain Console
Dashboards built from a plain-language question
Saved dashboards that refresh on every sync

items.name: Self-hosting guide for one instance per business
One-command self-hosted install
Managed hosting plan with upgrades and backups
